profile.summary: Business development and sales leader with 35+ years of progressive experience driving revenue growth and strategic account management. Specializes in complex solution selling to Fortune 500 clients, managing large-scale custom projects ($150K–$M+), and building high-performing sales teams. Demonstrates consistent track record of exceeding targets, opening new accounts, and expanding existing customer relationships; maintains $2.5M+ annual book of business and has achieved $6M+ in sales multiple times. Skilled in stakeholder engagement across C-suite, strategic planning, and designing customized engagement initiatives aligned with client business priorities.
